entities.name: Aspartate-semialdehyde dehydrogenase
observations: Supplied 340-aa sequence matches reviewed homologs at 66.7–68.2% identity over nearly full length; evidence supports assignment as aspartate-semialdehyde dehydrogenase (EC 1.2.1.11).
Homolog annotations indicate NADPH-dependent reductive dephosphorylation of L-aspartyl-4-phosphate to L-aspartate 4-semialdehyde.
Homolog pathway annotations connect the enzyme to de novo lysine (DAP pathway), methionine, and threonine biosynthesis; Pfam matches Semialdhyde_dh and Semialdhyde_dhC domains.

entities.name: L-aspartyl-4-phosphate reduction
observations: Rhea RHEA:24284: L-aspartate 4-semialdehyde + phosphate + NADP(+) = 4-phospho-L-aspartate + NADPH + H(+); cited as the reversible reaction associated with EC 1.2.1.11 homologs.

entities.name: Aspartate-family amino acid biosynthesis
observations: Aspartate-semialdehyde dehydrogenase homologs contribute to biosynthesis of lysine via the diaminopimelate pathway, methionine, and threonine.
